verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a Slack integration that watches for @openhands mentions and 'replies when the agent finishes' (openhands-docs-11), and CLI mode gives 'instant feedback' during interactive sessions (openhands-docs-1), which together support developers being notified of task completion. However there's no evidence of a dedicated notification system for 'needs my input' events, desktop/mobile push alerts, or email notifications beyond the Slack workflow. Missing for 10: explicit notification-on-input-needed mechanism, broader channel support (email/desktop), and independent confirmation of reliability.
